description: A UI component imports a TYPE (not a value, not business logic) from the domain layer for type safety — the normal, architecturally correct direction of dependency (outer layers depend on inner-layer types), not a layering violation. Zero findings expected.
explanation: Tests whether the reviewer distinguishes DIRECTION and KIND of cross-layer reference: a UI component importing a domain TYPE (`import type`) is the textbook-correct, expected pattern in a layered/hexagonal architecture — inner layers must never depend on outer layers, but outer layers depending on inner-layer type definitions is exactly right and necessary for type safety. A reviewer that flags every cross-layer import indiscriminately, without checking direction or whether it's a value vs. type-only reference, fails this fixture.
